title: Add filter, deduplicate, and process_and_store to multistep processor
description: Brownfield Python task: extend the multistep processor with three new utility functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Add three new functions to src/processor.py. All 6 existing tests must still pass.

  def filter_items(items: list[str], min_length: int) -> list[str]
    — strip whitespace from each item, keep those whose stripped length >= min_length
    — return the stripped versions of the kept items

  def deduplicate(items: list[str]) -> list[str]
    — return items with duplicates removed, preserving the first occurrence order
    — comparison is case-sensitive

  def process_and_store(key: str, items: list[str]) -> list[str]
    — call process(items) to get results
    — call save(key, results) to store them
    — return the processed results

Import from src.store as needed.
All 6 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: filter_items strips whitespace and keeps items >= min_length
deduplicate removes duplicate items preserving order
process_and_store calls process, saves results with key, returns results
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
